name: questionnaire
title: Questionnaire
description: A short set of questions asked one at a time, with choice cards, number or letter shortcuts, progress and one native form submit.
usage: Use for onboarding or feedback: what you are building, which APIs you need, how many calls a month. Give Questionnaire the items (name, required, multiple), then a QuestionnaireItem per question with QuestionnaireTitle, QuestionnaireDescription, QuestionnaireChoices of QuestionnaireChoice (and QuestionnaireInput for another answer) and QuestionnaireError, and QuestionnaireActions with Previous, Skip, Next and Submit. The answers submit as FormData.
avoid: More than one question on screen

reference.source: Extrapolated from context-dashboard c0ddf7a src/components/shell/support-chat.tsx (quick topics) and src/components/ui/form.tsx
